name: calm-enhance
description: Calm Enhance: an Enhance button above the prompt that turns a short, vague draft into a precise prompt from the recent conversation ("do 1 and 2" becomes the actual options). Press again to revert. Adapted from cc-prompt-enhance-mod by Yigit Budak (MIT).

model.title: Model
model.description: Which model rewrites the draft: sonnet (better at working out what "this" or "option 2" means) or haiku (faster and cheaper).
